title: Zanzibar: Frequently Asked Questions
excerpt: Frequently asked questions about Zanzibar: beaches, weather, culture, safety and how to get there.
body:
## Best time?
June–October and December–February. See [weather](/blog/zanzibar-weather-by-month/).

## Which beach?
See [east vs north](/blog/zanzibar-east-vs-north-coast/).

## Visa?
Tanzanian visa is valid. See [entry requirements](/blog/zanzibar-entry-requirements/).

## Dress code?
See [what to wear](/blog/zanzibar-dress-code/).

## Safe?
Generally, yes. Normal precautions.

## Malaria?
Yes. See [malaria](/blog/malaria-tanzania/).

## How many days?
See [how many days](/blog/how-many-days-zanzibar/).

## Excursions?
See [excursions by interest](/blog/best-zanzibar-excursions-by-interest/).

## Getting there?
Flight or ferry. See [the ferry](/blog/ferry-dar-es-salaam-zanzibar/).

## With kids?
See [Zanzibar with children](/blog/zanzibar-with-kids/).

[Plan your Zanzibar trip](/travel-proposal/).
